repos.description: Bulk file downloader for datanodes.to and fuckingfast.co — real-Chrome extraction over CDP, pure-HTTP extraction with a Chrome TLS fingerprint, aiohttp streaming, WebView2 GUI and a headless CLI. Windows, Python 3.10+, MIT.
Python package to download files on any topic in bulk.

findings.value: python moon_bridge.py --serve    # server only, prints the URL
python integration_http.py     # browser → loopback HTTP → engine (the path start.bat takes)
python render_gui.py out/           # renders at 2554x1400 and 1440x900 + overflow audit
python moon_engine.py          # headless engine: prints a snapshot and exits
